title: Malicious code in tailwindcss-animate-bridge (npm)
description: The tailwindcss-animate-bridge npm package contains malicious code that compromises any computer on which it is installed or running. The compromise is severe enough that all secrets and keys stored on the affected system should be rotated immediately from a different, clean computer. Removing the package alone may not eliminate all malicious software, as the attacker may have gained full control of the system.
